entries.source: You feel a surge of power as a powerful creature falls nearby.
entries.target: 你感受到一股力量的涌动，附近有个强大的生物倒下。

entries.source: %s feeds you hate from its latest victim. (+%d hate)
entries.target: %s 从它最近的受害者身上为你汲取仇恨。（+%d 仇恨）

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#The cease to exist spell fizzles and cancels, leaving the timeline intact.
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#存在抹杀技能失败并取消，时间线保持不变。

entries.source:
You have achieved #LIGHT_GREEN#level %d#WHITE# and gained a #LIGHT_GREEN#prodigy point#LAST#!

Prodigies are powerful talents with unique requirements that cannot be unlearned.
entries.target:
你升到了#LIGHT_GREEN#%d级#WHITE#，得到了一点#LIGHT_GREEN#觉醒点#LAST#!

觉醒技是需要特殊学习需求的强大技能，无法遗忘。

entries.source:
You have achieved #LIGHT_GREEN#level 50#WHITE#, congratulations!

This level is special, it granted you #LIGHT_GREEN#10#WHITE# more stat points, #LIGHT_GREEN#3#WHITE# more class talent points and #LIGHT_GREEN#3#WHITE# more generic talent points.
Now go forward boldly and triumph!
entries.target:
你达到了#LIGHT_GREEN#等级 50#WHITE#，祝贺你！

这个等级很特殊，你可以得到额外的#LIGHT_GREEN#10#WHITE#点属性点，#LIGHT_GREEN#3#WHITE#点职业技能点和#LIGHT_GREEN#3#WHITE#点通用技能点。
现在，勇敢地向前并取得胜利吧！
请按 P 键使用它们。

entries.source: Select %s in the party list and press G to use them.
entries.target: 请选择队伍里的%s，按 G 键使用它们。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#You have gained one more life (%d remaining).
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#你额外获得了一条命（剩余生命数：%d）。

entries.source: You cannot switch equipment while sleeping!
entries.target: 你不能在睡眠中切换装备！

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#You lose control and unleash an anomaly!
#LIGHT_RED#You feel the edges of spacetime begin to ripple and bend!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#你感到时空的边际开始弯曲振荡！

entries.source: You already tried to use %s, an instant use talent, this turn and failed.
entries.target: 你在本回合尝试使用瞬间技能%s失败，这回合无法再次使用。

entries.source: %s is too disconnected from Nature to use %s.
entries.target: %s与自然的联系过于微弱，无法使用%s。

entries.source: %s is unable to use this kind of inscription.
%s is too heavily armoured to use this talent.
%s can't use this talent while holding a weapon or shield.
entries.target: %s在装备武器或盾牌的时候，无法使用该技能。

entries.source: %s is sleeping and unable to do this.
You do not have enough feedback to use %s.
entries.target: 你的反馈值不足，无法使用%s。

entries.source: You do not have enough fortress energy to use %s.
entries.target: 你的堡垒能量不足，无法使用%s。

entries.source: You have too much %s to use %s.
You do not have enough %s to use %s.
You fail to use %s due to your equilibrium!
entries.target: 由于你的失衡值过高，你未能使用 %s！

%s fumbles and fails to use %s, injuring %s!
